project.name: Open Companion
project.summary: Customizable local companion with portable avatar runtime, persistent history/memory, and interchangeable inference/session adapters.
reference_products: Animates.ai: functional boundary evidence only; proprietary assets/code excluded

source_of_truth.design: Registered architecture artifacts and normative draft contracts
source_of_truth.implementation: Future code, migrations, tests, measured traces and human visual review; none yet

next_actions: Review the concrete draft defaults and scoped validation gates.
On a subsequent build request, create a clean Open-Companion project root, copy this architecture package, and begin WRK-001.
Obtain QST-001 API documentation only before the real user-stack mapping WRK-024.
current_focus.resume_notes: Architecture-only package. Draft structure/linkage/example checks passed; strict/approval gates intentionally fail on proposed decisions and unvalidated shaping assumptions. Six declaration files parsed but were not semantically typechecked. No app or live integration implemented/tested. See review/draft-review.md.
